correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the independent storm bit gives F(x,y)=p(x+y)+(1−2p)xy. Disjoint sibling subtrees use independent primitive bits. Write c=1−2p, u=F(q,q), d=u−q=−c q(1−q), k=p+cq and v=F(u,q)=u+kd. The balanced root probability is u+2kd+cd², while the comb root is u+k(1+k)d. Their gap is d[k(1−k)+cd]=p(1−p)d. Linearity of expectation adds u−v=−kd to this gap because the count includes the root; the resulting gap is −(p²+cq)d. The factor p²+cq=(1−q)p²+q(1−p)² is positive in the open square. The formulas also give the correct edge behavior: both differences vanish at q=0,1, but at p=0,1 only the root gap need vanish. Four leaves are minimal: root splits of 1+3 and 2+2 give the two shapes, with only one shape at each smaller leaf count. A separate exact 128-assignment polynomial enumeration agreed; the frozen CHECK.py was inspected, not run. The argument is for a single binary update, not a water-balance prediction.
